protocol: one pair, 60s settle, 8 samples at 8s intervals, docker stats --no-stream; identical for both sides

concurrency.note: legacy containers have NO resource limits, so macOS compressed ~3.4GB and continued rather than failing. The 9.8x per-pair RAM advantage therefore does not translate linearly into sessions on this host. The 1.7x measured result is close to the capacity model's 2.1x projection.

caveats: Legacy pair was measured WITHOUT --memory/--cpus, reproducing the pre-optimization state exactly. That is the correct baseline but means it could borrow unbounded host memory.
Concurrency ceiling was found by starting pairs in a loop and observing where docker refuses; not a controlled ramp with the benchmark harness.
macOS memory compression is not reproducible on Linux; a host without overcommit would likely show a larger concurrency ratio.
provenance: All values measured on this host on 2026-10-01. No value in this file is estimated or copied from another document.
